name: rsquirrel_lsp
description: Language server client for the RSquirrel scripting language

SquirrelLSP.VanillaDir.description: Main vanilla directory, should contain scripts.rson

SquirrelLSP.VanillaExtraDirs.description: Additional vanilla directories, if not using a full script-dump this may be needed. this should not include the VanillaDir and should immediately contain script files (IE, /scripts/vscripts should be in the path)

SquirrelLSP.Workspaces.description: Other target mods or workspaces(folders containing mods) to include, loaded after vanilla

SquirrelLSP.LoadFromGitLinks.description: [ Not implemented ] Download mods from github links

SquirrelLSP.LoadFromThunderstoreLinks.description: [ Not implemented ] Download mods from Thunderstore links

SquirrelLSP.maxNumberOfProblems.description: [ Dead, unused ]Controls the maximum number of problems produced by the server.

SquirrelLSP.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
